topic: Where was the first marathon race run? (Greece — Marathon to Athens, 1896 Olympics)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: The marathon has always been 42.195 km.
myths.reality: 1896 was about 40 km; 42.195 km dates from London 1908 and was made the official distance by the IAAF in 1921.

olympics_1896.title: Athens 1896 — Marathon men results
olympics_1896.notes: 10 April 1896; Spyridon Louis (GRE) 2:58:50; course Marathon → Panathenaic Stadium, ~40 km

olympics_louis.title: Spyridon Louis
olympics_louis.notes: water carrier from Marousi; won the first Olympic marathon in 1896 in 2:58:50

world_athletics.title: Marathon — discipline history
world_athletics.notes: first run at the 1896 Olympics (~40 km); 42.195 km from London 1908 (Windsor Castle to the White City stadium); standardised by the IAAF in 1921

britannica_marathon.title: marathon (running race)
britannica_marathon.notes: introduced at the 1896 Athens Olympics; distance ~40 km; set at 42,195 m in London 1908 (Windsor Castle start); official from 1921; Spyridon Louis first winner

wiki_marathon.title: Marathon
wiki_marathon.notes: 1896 Olympic marathon 40 km Marathon→Athens won by Spyridon Louis 2:58:50; 1908 London 26 mi 385 yd = 42.195 km Windsor Castle to White City; IAAF adopted in 1921

wiki_1896.title: Athletics at the 1896 Summer Olympics – Men's marathon
wiki_1896.notes: 10 April 1896; ~40 km from Marathon to the Panathenaic Stadium; winner Spyridon Louis 2:58:50; 17 starters

claims.text: The first marathon race was run at the 1896 Athens Olympics, from the town of Marathon to the Panathenaic Stadium, about 40 km.
vo: where was the first marathon race run
greece, the united kingdom, or the usa
greece: at the 1896 athens olympics, from the town of marathon to the stadium, about forty kilometres

claims.text: Spyridon Louis, a Greek water carrier, won in 2:58:50.
vo: the winner was a greek water carrier, spyridon louis, in just under three hours

claims.text: At London 1908 the course ran 42.195 km (26 mi 385 yd) from Windsor Castle to the White City stadium.
vo: in london in 1908 the course was stretched to 42.195 kilometres, so it could start at windsor castle

claims.text: 42.195 km became the official marathon distance in 1921 (IAAF) and remains so.
vo: that odd distance became the official marathon in 1921, and it has never changed since

claims.text: The race was born in Greece (1896) and its distance fixed by the London 1908 course.
vo: born in greece, measured in london
